svg.title: The design system, from tokens to components
svg.desc: Authored: the palette, the roles and the resolver in design-system/tokens/, and the components contract and the rules in DESIGN.md. Build: design:export checks the components contract, then Terrazzo resolves light and dark. Generated, never edited: tokens.generated.css holds every token as a variable, theme.generated.css the roles as the Tailwind theme with a dark variant. Consumed: Tailwind 4, with its own palette reset, feeds the components, which use role classes only. Four checks run on every edit and commit: the ESLint design rules, design:lint, design:export --check and the agent hooks. a token change: palette, roles, resolver → Terrazzo → tokens.generated.css, theme.generated.css → Tailwind 4 → components. the contract: components → contract check → components.
svg.text: ENFORCEMENT, ON EVERY EDIT AND COMMIT
